## Relationships

### [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--grandma-stanhope.md)

Grandma Stanhope is the paternal grandmother of [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md). Her daughter-in-law, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), proposes moving the widowed [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) following [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) Sowerby's death to allow [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to pursue her studies.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), +5 more_

- Relative of — grandson  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024), +1 more</sub>

### [Stanhope](../character/stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-stanhope--stanhope.md)

Grandma Stanhope is the paternal grandmother responsible for raising [Stanhope](../character/stanhope.md).

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012)_
